items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well, the fella that we had was playing piano with us by the name, his name is Bruce.

ctx.x: I don't even know that band, the Buccaneers. I don't remember that. You know, I don't know.

I remember the time we went down to play the picnic down there. I forget the name of the place. The guy saw the bills on our side, the Buccaneers. The guy came, he didn't know I was in the band. He pitched by me, man, where'd that band come from? Come from a bunch of cowboys, man. Man, we don't go any bad Buccaneers. So after we got it we played a few numbers, man. The guy was, man, those fellas can play, man. And long enough time the hall was crowded, man. Well, the fella that we had was playing piano with us by…
Bruce huh? Yeah, Bruce. That's not Baby Bruce. No, no, not Baby Bruce.
